content.text: Found a real bug: hooks set after `JSONDecoder()` construction don't affect the C scanner. Let me fix by passing them to the constructor.

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''def parse_document(text):
    dec = json.JSONDecoder()
    dec.object_pairs_hook = _pairs_hook
    dec.parse_constant = _reject_constant
    dec.parse_float = _reject_float
'''
new = '''def parse_document(text):
    dec = json.JSONDecoder(object_pairs_hook=_pairs_hook,
                           parse_constant=_reject_constant,
                           parse_float=_reject_float)
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
